{"schema":1,"fields":[{"key":"progressPrefix","label":"进度备注","description":"附加在任务进度前，不改变任务条件。","type":"string","default":"","minLength":0,"maxLength":20},{"key":"nextActionDelayMs","label":"额外动作间隔（毫秒）","description":"0 沿用原流程；可增加到 1000 毫秒，不改变页面归属、停止和安全检查。","type":"int","default":0,"min":0,"max":1000},{"key":"install.maxTasks","label":"本轮最多安装几个应用","type":"int","default":13,"min":1,"max":13,"unit":"个","description":"每个应用仍按原流程完成打开、停留和领奖。达到数量后收工，不缩短单次任务。"},{"key":"install.targetBalance","label":"钱包金币总额目标","description":"读取钱包已有金币总额；这不是本轮新增金币。已达目标时不再安装。","type":"int","default":1000,"min":1,"max":1000,"unit":"金币"},{"key":"install.maxRefreshes","label":"无任务时最多换一换次数","type":"int","default":3,"min":0,"max":3},{"key":"install.extraDwellMs","label":"额外停留（毫秒）","description":"仅增加原停留时长；安装、打开、领奖及唯一新增应用清理仍是完整流程。","type":"int","default":0,"min":0,"max":10000},{"key":"install.cleanupInstalled","label":"领奖后卸载本轮新装应用","description":"仅处理本轮唯一确认的新装应用；原来已安装的应用不会卸载。关闭后保留新装应用。","type":"boolean","default":true}],"layout":{"groups":[{"id":"goal","title":"本轮目标","fields":["install.maxTasks","install.targetBalance"]},{"id":"cleanup","title":"任务完成后","fields":["install.cleanupInstalled"]},{"id":"install-advanced","title":"安装兼容设置","fields":["install.maxRefreshes","install.extraDwellMs"],"advanced":true},{"id":"advanced","title":"高级设置","fields":["progressPrefix","nextActionDelayMs"],"advanced":true}]}}

{"schema":3,"id":"quietstart.movie-free-member-install","name":"视频免会员安装任务","version":7,"usage":"在视频「我的」页，常用服务里点击「免费领会员」进入免费领视频会员页面。轻启先读取当前金币，达到 1000 即停止；不足时按每项 80 金币依次安装。点任务「打开」后，即使新应用弹出网络或权限窗口，也无需操作；轻启等待 5 秒就直接唤回视频，并核对任务奖励。最多完成 13 项，同一应用再次显示「安装」也会继续做。确认任务完成后尝试卸载本次新安装的应用；没有任务时点「换一换」，连续 3 次仍没有任务便结束。","appliesTo":["com.huawei.hmsapp.himovie"],"entryAfterClick":"免费领会员","rewardInstall":{"pageText":"免费领会员","taskActionText":"安装","taskOpenText":"打开","taskDoneText":"已打开","balancePrefix":"我的金币：","targetBalance":1000,"pointsPerTask":80,"marketText":"应用市场","marketNameId":"app_name","marketActionId":"download_button_text","refreshText":"换一换","taskRegion":[0.04,0.3,0.97,0.99],"refreshRegion":[0.62,0.11,0.99,0.95],"marketCloseRegion":[0.83,0.02,0.99,0.11],"dwellMs":5000,"maxRefreshes":3,"maxTasks":13,"cleanupInstalled":true,"scrollSpeed":800,"returnModuleName":"entry","returnAbilityName":"MainAbility"},"tasks":[]}
